editorial_plan.central_question: 投资者如何从云业务需求、收入和营业利润，走到对 AI 基础设施现金回报的判断；现有 Q2 披露在哪一步停止提供证据？
editorial_plan.title: AI 云增长很快，投资回报走到了哪一步？

summary: Amazon 报告 AWS Q2 收入422亿美元、营业利润166亿美元，集团 TTM 自由现金流净流出76亿美元；Google 报告云收入增长82%、订单积压5140亿美元（[Amazon](https://ir.aboutamazon.com/news-release/news-release-details/2026/Amazon-com-Announces-Second-Quarter-Results/default.aspx)；[Google](https://blog.google/company-news/inside-google/message-ceo/alphabet-earnings-q2-2026/)）。这些披露支持商业进展，但尚未配对新增 AI 资本与持续现金产出。
summary_en: Amazon reported AWS Q2 sales of $42.2 billion and operating income of $16.6 billion alongside negative $7.6 billion consolidated TTM free cash flow; Google reported 82% Cloud revenue growth and $514 billion backlog ([Amazon](https://ir.aboutamazon.com/news-release/news-release-details/2026/Amazon-com-Announces-Second-Quarter-Results/default.aspx); [Google](https://blog.google/company-news/inside-google/message-ceo/alphabet-earnings-q2-2026/)). These disclosures support commercial progress while leaving incremental AI capital and cash returns unmatched.
title: AI 云增长很快，投资回报走到了哪一步？
title_en: How much do AI cloud growth figures tell us about investment returns?
